positioning.text: Physicist specialized in computational astrophysics, applying data analysis and machine learning across scientific and industrial projects.
Data science, high-end computing and simulations, astrophysics, data analysis.
Statistical analysis, mathematical modeling, optimization, computing, data structures.
Programming languages (Python, R) enabling deep handling, optimization and insights from data.
Leverage his skills and knowledge to make valuable contributions.
Mathematics, physics, programming and data science.
Artificial intelligence, statistics, physics and programming.
Detail-oriented, organized, driven team player, committed to high-quality work; self-confident and kind.
Self-taught from a young age, applying what he learns.

bullets.text: Drove data mining and EDA efforts for the MANPREDIC project, providing critical insights for supervised predictive maintenance of Spanish land army truck vehicles.
Continuously tested model effectiveness metrics over time to optimize predictive accuracy.
Leveraged diagnostic techniques to identify opportunities for model upgrades, improving outcomes.

notes.text: Deuser is now part of Indra Group.

bullets.text: Used SQL to extract business insights from multiple sources, cleaning data and performing exploratory data analysis in R and Python for the PREDCAM project.
Leveraged national and European APIs (IFAPA, MAPA, Copernicus-Land) to feed CNN models with satellite images.
Used H2O and PyTorch for image processing and model development.
Regularly used Python and R frameworks, applying unsupervised methods such as PCA, K-Means and DBScan to new problems.

notes.text: Work came through the platforms Freelancer, Upwork and Fiverr.

bullets.text: Data wrangling, EDA, ML/DL model training and statistical analysis for clients.
Used Python and R frameworks and unsupervised methods such as PCA, K-Means and DBScan to customize solutions to client needs.
Leveraged diverse APIs for data mining, economics, georeferencing, web scraping and other tasks.
Model validation, and specific jobs on clustering, georeferencing and ETL.
Developed a CNN encoder-decoder architecture (U-Net) to detect high-density, high-energy-emission starburst clusters in a hydrodynamical simulation of galaxies.
Used Python, data science libraries and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and Keras to extract information and define the learning model.
Leveraged astrophysics segmentation software and GPU-related software, including NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit, to optimize computation.
Collaborated with professors to coach students in Calculus subjects with practical examples, across all first-year groups.
Presented seminars on Mathematica and Maple software, on his own initiative.
Conveyed technical information to diverse audiences.
